items.name: Eggshell Charm
items.lore: A brewing eggshell, cracked and bound in silver wire. It made a changeling laugh once.

items.name: Blackthorn Ring
items.lore: A ring of blackthorn wood, hard as iron, thorns turned inward. It doesn't prick. Usually.

items.name: Cradle-Song Sash
items.lore: Embroidered with the words of a Hibernian lullaby, and something under the words, in faerie script.

items.name: Fae-Milk Mantle
items.lore: Soft as a baby's blanket. It belonged to a faerie child, for a little while.

items.name: Sealskin Cloak
items.lore: Grey and silver, softer than any wool. It smells of the sea and it always will.

items.name: Roane-Pearl Pendant
items.lore: A grey pearl from deep water, the kind the roane give as wedding-gifts.

items.name: Fergal's Net-Knot Bracer
items.lore: A fisherman's bracer, knotted the way only Fergal knots.

items.name: Skinner's Ring
items.lore: Taken from a dergan who skinned the roane for their pelts. Scrub it as you like.
